"""Native-free admission for the bounded schema-3 Part geometry actions.

This selects source intent only. Fresh replay still owns solving, sector
classification, construction and geometry validation; admission is no certificate.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .errors import CADException
from .model import Document
from .result_policy_v3 import validate_replay_v3


def validate_geometry_v3(document: Document, result_version: int) -> None:
    """Require one directed sector and its sole selected direct extrusion.

    Compose the existing replay policy, including its height/expression bounds.
    Unused points and constraints retain their existing semantics. Neither a solve
    nor a zero-DoF requirement belongs in this structural, native-free gate.
    """
    validate_replay_v3(document, result_version)
    profiles = [
        feature
        for feature in document.features
        if feature.kind == "sketch_constrained" and feature.sketch is not None
    ]
    if not any(profile.sketch.schema_version == 3 and profile.sketch.arcs for profile in profiles):
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_geometry_source", "Geometry result 3 requires a schema-3 sector source."
        )
    if document.active_feature is None:
        raise CADException(
            "missing_active_feature", "Choose an active solid before checking or exporting."
        )
    active = next(feature for feature in document.features if feature.id == document.active_feature)
    if active.kind != "extrude":
        raise CADException(
            "not_a_solid", "Geometry checks and export require the selected sector extrusion."
        )
    if len(document.features) != 2 or len(profiles) != 1:
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_profile_graph",
            "Geometry result 3 requires one sector sketch and its selected direct extrusion.",
        )
    profile = profiles[0]
    extrusion = next(feature for feature in document.features if feature is not profile)
    if (
        extrusion.kind != "extrude"
        or dict(extrusion.inputs) != {"profile": profile.id}
        or document.active_feature != extrusion.id
    ):
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_profile_graph",
            "Geometry result 3 requires the sole direct extrusion to be selected.",
        )
    sketch = profile.sketch
    if (
        sketch.schema_version != 3
        or len(sketch.arcs) != 1
        or len(sketch.lines) != 2
        or sketch.circles
    ):
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_profile_form",
            "Geometry result 3 requires one schema-3 arc and two shared-ID radial lines.",
        )
    arc = sketch.arcs[0]
    expected = {frozenset((arc.center, arc.start)), frozenset((arc.center, arc.end))}
    if {frozenset((line.start, line.end)) for line in sketch.lines} != expected:
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_profile_form", "Sector radial lines must use the arc's point IDs."
        )
    if sketch.plane.origin != (0, 0, 0) or sketch.plane.quaternion != (1, 0, 0, 0):
        raise CADException(
            "unsupported_native_frame",
            "Geometry result 3 requires exact zero workplane origin and identity quaternion.",
        )
